hardening_notes: In .github/workflows/ci.yml, pin actions/checkout and astral-sh/setup-uv to full commit SHAs, add explicit `permissions: contents: read`, and run `uv sync --locked --extra dev` (and `uv run --frozen --no-sync` in scripts/serve_studio.sh) to prevent lockfile drift.

local_checks.invariant: Unauthenticated requests to /api/* (except /api/health minimal probe and CORS OPTIONS preflight) are rejected with 401 and cannot bypass middleware via path normalization or middleware ordering.
local_checks.result: handle_security_and_auth gates all /api/* paths (except OPTIONS and /api/health, which independently requires admin role in studio.py:52 for preflight details) before call_next. CORSMiddleware is registered outermost with explicit origin allowlist (_build_allowed_origins, no wildcard with credentials). FastAPI routes do not collapse //api/ paths into /api/ routes.

local_checks.invariant: Listener role (LISTEN_TOKEN) is restricted to read-only GET/HEAD playback, timeline, export, metadata, and RSS endpoints and cannot reach admin mutations, reports, Show Bible, or health preflight; query tokens cannot authenticate as admin on audio/RSS endpoints.
local_checks.result: _is_listener_allowed_api restricts non-admin callers to GET/HEAD on exact _LISTENER_GET_PATHS (/api/meta, /api/episodes, /api/rss-url) and _LISTENER_EPISODE_GET_RE (^/api/episodes/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/(?:timeline|audio|srt|shownotes)$). All POST/PUT/DELETE routes and GET /api/reports, /api/show-bible return 403 for listeners. /api/health checks SESSION_TOKEN only (allow_query_token=False). /api/episodes/*/audio and /feed.xml pass allow_query_admin=False.

local_checks.invariant: Cookie-authenticated state-changing endpoints and vp_session cookie scope/transport resist cross-site request forgery and insecure cookie leakage.
local_checks.result: vp_session cookie is set host-only (no Domain attribute), Path=/, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and Secure when _is_https_request() is true. All mutating routes are POST, PUT, or DELETE; SameSite=Lax blocks cross-site requests with cookies, and locked FastAPI 0.162.7 strict_content_type=True requires application/json on JSON POST bodies while CORSMiddleware blocks untrusted origins from preflighted JSON/PUT/DELETE requests. Note: GET /?token=<LISTEN_TOKEN> is a top-level GET that can overwrite an admin cookie to listener (see hardening).

hardening_notes: vibe_podcast/auth.py:82-93 (_match_token_role): Encode candidate and expected tokens to UTF-8 bytes before calling hmac.compare_digest; passing a non-ASCII str (e.g., UTF-8 query param or Latin-1 decoded header) raises TypeError (HTTP 500) and skips apply_security_headers.

vibe_podcast/auth.py:160-177 (handle_security_and_auth): GET /?token=<LISTEN_TOKEN> is a state-changing top-level GET without CSRF protection; an invited listener who knows LISTEN_TOKEN can navigate an admin to /?token=<LISTEN_TOKEN> and downgrade the admin's vp_session cookie to listener (Login CSRF). Exchange tokens via POST /api/login (JSON body) with explicit opaque session IDs and rotation/logout support.

vibe_podcast/auth.py:163-197: Add Cache-Control: no-store to early-return responses (especially the 302 Set-Cookie redirect on GET /?token= and 401/403 responses) rather than only call_next() responses.

vibe_podcast/routes/episodes.py:187-200 (_resolve_public_base_url) & vibe_podcast/auth.py:128-138 (_is_https_request): Read request.url.scheme/netloc (populated by uvicorn --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips) or validate Host/X-Forwarded-Host against an explicit allowlist when VIBEPODCAST_PUBLIC_URL is unset, instead of reading raw X-Forwarded-Proto/X-Forwarded-Host headers directly.

vibe_podcast/routes/episodes.py:101-104 (get_episode_timeline): Listener-accessible /api/episodes/{id}/timeline returns full SynthesisResult including server-side absolute filesystem paths (audio_path, timeline_path); consider stripping or relativizing internal paths in listener responses.

local_checks.invariant: Host and X-Forwarded-* headers cannot be abused across principals to poison cached responses, redirect targets, or cookie security.
local_checks.result: serve_studio.sh sets --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips=127.0.0.1, though _resolve_public_base_url (episodes.py:192-199) and _is_https_request (auth.py:130) read raw x-forwarded-proto/x-forwarded-host headers directly when VIBEPODCAST_PUBLIC_URL is unset. Spoofing X-Forwarded-Proto: https only upgrades Secure=True (cannot downgrade to false). _resolve_public_base_url only feeds authenticated /api/rss-url and /feed.xml responses that carry Cache-Control: no-store and validate host via _HOST_HEADER_RE, preventing cross-user cache poisoning or XML injection in source.

local_checks.invariant: Response headers (Location, Set-Cookie, Content-Disposition, CSP) are free of untrusted control-character or attribute injection.
local_checks.result: RedirectResponse on GET /?token= uses static url='/'; Set-Cookie value is accepted only after exact hmac.compare_digest match against configured/generated tokens; Content-Disposition filenames on /srt and /shownotes require _EPISODE_ID_RE (^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$); apply_security_headers sets fixed X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and CSP values.
